# notekeeper

notekeeper keeps your notes where you work. You write in plain text, and it takes care of the rest.

## Getting started

Install it once, and you are ready. Open your notes folder and notekeeper indexes everything you have. When you search, you get answers from your own words, not from a cloud you never asked for.

## What you get

You can tag, link and pin. Your notes stay on your disk, in files you can read with any editor. If you ever want to leave, you take everything with you.
